content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in early periods (e.g., 2023-12-20, 2024-05-07) — adjust forecast upward by 2–5% for initial 5–10 days.
- Overestimates after sharp price spikes (e.g., 2023-12-20, 2024-05-08) — reduce forecast by 3–8% for 3–7 days post-spike.
- Shows mean reversion bias — forecasts drift downward too quickly after peaks; add 1–3% upward momentum for 3–5 days post-peak.
- Underestimates in low-price regimes (e.g., 2024-05-07–09) — increase baseline by 5–10% for 10–15 days if recent 30d mean < 65.
- Forecasts lag true price movements by 1–3 days — shift forecast 1–2 days ahead for short-term (0–7d) and 3–5 days ahead for medium-term (8–20d).
